scope: One unchanged optimized package, three application open/highlight/switch/dismiss sequences and three keyboard plus three pointer heading changes. PAL-frame pixel samples, passive CPU boundaries. No native Windows-menu or p95 claim.
limitations: Three samples per standard action are not a percentile study.
Pointer timings include physical travel and repeated motion; use keyboard for the clean scene baseline.
IRQ completion is not an independently sampled BUSY falling edge.
Inclusive routines overlap; do not add parent and child costs.
Cache counters include the settled tail; CPU costs stop at the matching pixel sample.
Recommendations are unimplemented and their savings require matched measurement.
